short_film.rule: The fixed short-film cut depicts Lumina restoring a streetlight. This is the short-film presentation and is not a selectable game outcome.

interactive_game.rule: CHOICE_LUMINA_01A, CHOICE_LUMINA_01B, and CHOICE_LUMINA_01C are mutually exclusive alternative adaptations. Exactly one may be selected in a game playthrough; none is an additional event in the fixed short-film cut.

cross_track_rules: Never apply the short-film streetlight restoration and one of the interactive Episode 1 alternatives as two sequential Lumina expenditures in the same continuity.
Episode 2 and later game-state transitions must use the interactive-game track only.
Do not merge short-film and interactive-game resource histories without an explicit adaptation mapping approved by a human.
